perpetual_chaos_game — GENERATIVE perpetual op

• Data kinds: none → rgb (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.perpetual_chaos_game(points: 'int' = 400000, size: 'int' = 520, seed: 'int' = 0, vertices: 'int' = 3, ratio: 'float' = 0.5, sub: 'int' = 2) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import perpetual; perpetual.perpetual_chaos_game(points: 'int' = 400000, size: 'int' = 520, seed: 'int' = 0, vertices: 'int' = 3, ratio: 'float' = 0.5, sub: 'int' = 2) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsgenerative.get("perpetual_chaos_game"))

Usage

Chaos game — just rolling a die and moving halfway each time produces the Sierpiński triangle.

Invariant: the box-counting dimension of the attractor with 3 vertices and ratio 1/2 is log3/log2 = 1.5850.

★How you draw it changes the ground truth you can measure. Even for the same point sequence, the dimension measured from a picture built by truncating and accumulating deviates from the ground truth by −0.032, whereas drawing with bilinear + asinh gives −0.0030 -- 10 times more accurate (threshold 0.1, measured). The tones are not decoration.
